objective_pt: Fazer uma proposta, recusar com educação e oferecer uma contraproposta com "if" ("If you can..., we could...").

teacher.goal_pt: Conversar sobre negociações do dia a dia (salário, preço, prazo) e ver como o aluno pede algo.
prompts: Have you ever negotiated a price or a salary?
watchFor: Dizer "make a discount"; o natural é "give a discount".

exercises.prompt: Is there any room for negotiation on the price?
accepted: Is there any room for negotiation on the price?
Is there any room to negotiate on the price?

exercises.instruction_pt: What does "compromise" mean in a negotiation?
options: Each side gives up something to reach an agreement
exercises.explanation_pt: "Compromise" é um meio-termo, um acordo em que cada lado cede. "Compromisso" de agenda é "appointment"; compromisso no sentido de dedicação é "commitment".

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Você pode me dar um desconto?"
accepted: Can you give me a discount?
Could you give me a discount?
Can I get a discount?
Could I get a discount?
Is there any chance of a discount?
Can you offer me a discount?
Could you offer me a discount?
Would you give me a discount?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Fazer um desconto" em inglês é "give a discount" ou "offer a discount", não "make".
commonErrors.correction_en: Could you give me a discount?

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender expressões de negociação: meet halfway, deal, counteroffer, bottom line, terms.
prompts: What's your bottom line when you buy a car?
watchFor: Pronunciar "deal" como "dil"; o "ea" é longo, e o "l" final é escuro.
Dizer "close a deal" como "close an agreement"; os dois existem, mas "close a deal" é mais natural.

exercises.meaning_pt: chegar a um meio-termo, cada um ceder um pouco
exercises.example_en: Why don't we meet halfway and split the difference?
They rejected our price and made a counteroffer.
Free delivery and a five percent discount? It's a deal.

exercises.instruction_pt: Match each expression to its meaning.
Say it in English: "Que tal a gente chegar a um meio-termo?"
accepted: How about we meet halfway?
How about meeting halfway?
Why don't we meet halfway?
What if we meet halfway?
Shall we meet halfway?
Let's meet halfway
Why don't we meet in the middle?
How about we meet in the middle?
How about a compromise?
Why don't we find a compromise?
Can we find a compromise?
Let's split the difference

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Meio-termo" não vira "middle term". Use "meet halfway", "meet in the middle" ou "compromise".
"Chegar a um meio-termo" é uma expressão fixa: "meet halfway" ou "reach a compromise".

teacher.goal_pt: Treinar a entonação firme mas educada e o "l" escuro de "deal" e "deadline".
prompts: Say "deal" and "deadline". Do you hear the "l"?
How do you say no politely with your voice?
watchFor: Transformar o "l" final em "u" ("deau"), como no português.
Usar um tom de pergunta em uma recusa firme.

exercises.instruction_pt: Repeat. Keep the "l" in "deal" and "still": the tongue touches the top of the mouth.
exercises.prompt: I'm afraid that's still not a good deal for us.
accepted: I'm afraid that's still not a good deal for us.
I am afraid that is still not a good deal for us.

exercises.prompt: If you can pay upfront, we could lower the price.
accepted: If you can pay upfront, we could lower the price.
If you can pay up front, we could lower the price.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "if" não usamos "will" para condição: "If you can pay" ou "If you pay".
commonErrors.correction_en: If you can pay upfront, we could lower the price.

exercises.instruction_pt: Which word has the same vowel sound as "deal"?
exercises.explanation_pt: "Deal" e "meet" têm o "i" longo. "Did" tem o "i" curto, e "dell" tem o som de "é".

teacher.goal_pt: Entender propostas com condição e reagir com uma contraproposta.
prompts: What would you say if a supplier asks for more money?
How do you say "no" without closing the door?
watchFor: Recusar com "No, impossible", que soa rude; preferir "I'm afraid we can't...".

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen. What does the supplier offer?
exercises.listen: If you order five hundred units, we can throw in free shipping.
options: Free shipping for a big order
exercises.explanation_pt: "Throw in" é incluir algo de brinde. A condição é encomendar 500 unidades.

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen. Politely say you can't accept that price.
exercises.listen: Our final price is fifty dollars per unit.
accepted: I'm afraid that's too high for us
I'm afraid we can't accept that price
I'm afraid we can't go that high
I'm sorry, but that's too expensive for us
Unfortunately, that's too high for us
Unfortunately, we can't accept that
That's a bit too high for us
I'm afraid that's above our budget
That's more than we can pay
I'm afraid that doesn't work for us
I'm sorry, but we can't accept that price

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de preposição usamos "us", não "we": "too expensive for us".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm sorry, but that's too expensive for us.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "can" ou "can't" o verbo vem sem "to": "we can't accept".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm afraid we can't accept that price.

exercises.listen: Okay, forty-five dollars per unit and free shipping. What do you say?
accepted: It's a deal
Deal
That's a deal
You've got a deal
Okay, it's a deal
Sounds good, it's a deal
That works for us
We accept
We can accept that
Yes, that works for us
Great, we have a deal
Agreed

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Fechado!" no sentido de combinado é "It's a deal" ou "Deal!". "Closed" soa como uma loja fechada.

teacher.goal_pt: Negociar prazo ou preço em uma simulação, com proposta, recusa e contraproposta.
prompts: I need this project done in two weeks. Can you do it?
watchFor: Aceitar tudo sem negociar; incentivar o "If you..., we could...".

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Se vocês aumentarem o prazo, a gente pode baixar o preço."
accepted: If you extend the deadline, we can lower the price
If you extend the deadline, we could lower the price
If you give us more time, we can lower the price
If you give us more time, we could lower the price
If you push back the deadline, we can lower the price
If you push the deadline back, we could lower the price
If you extend the deadline, we can reduce the price
If you extend the deadline, we could bring the price down
If you can extend the deadline, we can lower the price

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em frases com "if" sobre uma condição, não usamos "will" depois do "if": "If you extend...".
commonErrors.correction_en: If you extend the deadline, we can lower the price.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Prazo não "aumenta" em inglês: ele é "extended" ou "pushed back".
commonErrors.correction_en: If you extend the deadline, we can lower the price.

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Infelizmente, isso é o máximo que podemos oferecer."
accepted: Unfortunately, that's the best we can offer
Unfortunately, that's the most we can offer
Unfortunately, this is the best we can offer
Unfortunately, this is the most we can offer
I'm afraid that's the best we can offer
I'm afraid that's the most we can offer
Unfortunately, that's as far as we can go
I'm afraid that's as far as we can go
Unfortunately, that's our best offer
Unfortunately, that's our final offer

commonErrors.correction_en: Unfortunately, that's the best we can offer.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "The maximum we can offer" se entende, mas o natural é "the best" ou "the most we can offer".
commonErrors.correction_en: Unfortunately, that's the best we can offer.

exercises.instruction_pt: Put the words in order to make a counteroffer.
accepted: What if we split the difference

exercises.instruction_pt: Negotiate. The client wants a lower price. Refuse politely and make a counteroffer.
exercises.prompt_en: We love your proposal, but the price is too high. Can you do it for twenty percent less?
guidelines_pt: Thank them and refuse politely: "I'm afraid we can't go that low."
Make a counteroffer with "if": "If you..., we could..."
Try to close: "Do we have a deal?"

teacher.goal_pt: Revisar as expressões de negociação e as frases com "if".
prompts: How do you refuse an offer politely?
How do you say "fechado" in a negotiation?

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Eles recusaram a nossa proposta."
accepted: They turned down our proposal
They turned our proposal down
They rejected our proposal
They refused our proposal
They said no to our proposal
They turned down our offer
They rejected our offer

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Recuse" em inglês é um juiz se declarar impedido. "Recusar" é "turn down", "reject" ou "refuse".

exercises.sentence: If you ___ more units, we'll give you a discount.
accepted: order
buy
purchase

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "if" na condição usamos o presente: "If you order...". O "will" fica na outra parte da frase.
commonErrors.correction_en: If you order more units, we'll give you a discount.

exercises.instruction_pt: Which sentence is the most polite way to say no?
options: I'm afraid we can't accept that.
exercises.explanation_pt: "I'm afraid..." suaviza a recusa e mantém a negociação aberta. As outras soam secas.

exercises.prompt: Great. I think we have a deal.
accepted: Great. I think we have a deal.
Great, I think we've got a deal.
